claims.claim: bounded-memory churn: population never exceeds CAP under arrivals + damage + pruning (per-step cost stays O(CAP^2))

self-healing without a repair unit: after each random neuron death the local k-NN re-spread keeps the survivors in the healthy consensus-spacing band (post within 0.5-2.0x of pre - removing a neuron legitimately enlarges mean k-NN distance), no clump and no rim blow-up
routing intact through churn: self-consistent k-NN probe stays accurate after thousands of ticks of arrivals, damage and pruning
checkpoint/resume is lossless: a session resumed from a checkpoint reproduces the uninterrupted trajectory (positions, counters, RNG stream) deterministically

verdict: SUPPORTED (structural, bounded run): the live daemon's population stays within CAP through arrivals, damage and pruning; the local k-NN re-spread heals each random death back to the healthy spacing band with no repair unit; the self-consistent routing probe stays accurate through churn; and a checkpoint/resume reproduces the uninterrupted trajectory deterministically - all on the repo's own numpy-only DecentralNet with bounded ring memory
